title: Malicious code in solana-keypair (RubyGems)
description: The solana-keypair RubyGem version 0.1.0 is a malicious package that exfiltrates sensitive user data during installation. Its extconf.rb script reads various secret files and environment variables related to cryptocurrency keys and credentials, encodes this data, and sends it to a hardcoded external URL. The package masquerades as legitimate Solana tooling but contains no real native extension code, instead writing a no-op Makefile to conceal its malicious behavior.
